text: 伯纳德脚下一滑！那惊心动魄的一刻，他跌进急流。你正要扑过去，却见学生抓住水下的岩架，自己站起身来，浑身湿透但安然无恙。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 642
text: Bernard missteps! For a nail-biting moment, he goes down into the rushing water. You prepare to lunge—but the student finds an underwater grip on the ledge and hauls himself to his feet, sodden, but unharmed.
